body.condition: Every \(\mathcal A\in\mathfrak A_{\mathrm{det}}\) has a main-wave rate converging locally uniformly in probability to one deterministic \(r\in\mathcal R_B\).

novel.justification: Prospective validation protocols commonly require investigators to freeze a stable acquisition rule after a pilot; deterministic limiting rates formalize that precommitment while allowing finite-sample pilot adaptation.
